words.definition_en: An atoning sacrifice that turns away wrath, satisfies divine justice, and reconciles a sinner with God.
words.definition_te: పాపపరిహారార్థ బలి / దేవుని న్యాయమైన కోపమును శాంతిపరచి సమాధానపరచు ప్రాయశ్చిత్తము.

chapters.Romans 3: In Romans 3:25, Paul uses 'propitiation' to refer to Christ as our ultimate 'Mercy Seat' (hilasterion), where God's absolute holiness and immense love meet, completely wiping away our sin through Jesus' blood.
chapters.1 John 2: In 1 John 2:2, John comforts believers who fall into sin that Jesus is not only our defense Advocate, but Himself the sacrifice that settles the debt of the whole world.
chapters.1 John 4: In 1 John 4:10, propitiation demonstrates that true love originated from God sending His Son, not from our love toward Him.

words.definition_en: The vast expanse of the sky or atmosphere separating the celestial realm from the earth.

chapters.Genesis 1: In Genesis 1:6-8, on the second day of Creation, God formed the 'firmament' (Hebrew: Raqiya) to separate the waters above (clouds/atmosphere) from the waters below (seas).
chapters.Psalms 19: In Psalm 19:1, 'The firmament sheweth his handywork' means the night sky and galaxies declare the cosmic craftsmanship of the Creator.

words.definition_en: To earnestly, tenderly, and passionately plead with someone out of love rather than harsh command.
words.definition_te: అధికారముతో ఆజ్ఞాపించక ప్రేమతో బతిమాలుకొనుట లేదా వేడుకొనుట.

chapters.Romans 12: In Romans 12:1 ('I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God...'), Paul tenderly implores believers to dedicate their bodies as living sacrifices as a willing response to God's immense mercy.

words.definition_en: Made alive; resurrected from spiritual deadness into vibrant, supernatural life.
words.definition_te: ఆత్మీయ మరణములో నుండి నూతనముగా బ్రతికించబడుట / సజీవులుగా చేయబడుట.

chapters.Ephesians 2: In Ephesians 2:1 ('And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins'), Paul contrasts our previous condition as spiritually lifeless corpses with the resurrection life imparted by Christ.
chapters.Romans 8: In Romans 8:11, the Holy Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead will also 'quicken' our mortal bodies.

words.definition_en: A Hebrew musical or liturgical directive meaning 'stop, pause, and meditate deeply on what was just said'.
words.definition_te: సంగీతములో మరియు కీర్తనలలో ఆగి, చెప్పబడిన సత్యమును ధ్యానించుటకు ఇవ్వబడిన విరామము.

chapters.Psalms: Appears over 70 times in Psalms, reminding the worshiper not to rush, but to let the weight of God's majesty and truth sink into the heart.

words.definition_en: God's unmerited, unearned divine favor and power given freely to those who deserve judgment.
words.definition_te: మన అర్హతను బట్టి కాక దేవుడు ఉచితముగా అనుగ్రహించు దైవిక దయ మరియు కనికరము.

chapters.Ephesians 2: In Ephesians 2:8 ('For by grace are ye saved through faith... not of works'), grace highlights that salvation is a 100% free gift, not a wage earned by human effort.

words.definition_en: A legal decree by God in which a sinner is declared completely righteous and pardoned through faith in Jesus Christ.
words.definition_te: క్రీస్తునందలి విశ్వాసము ద్వారా దేవుని న్యాయపీఠము ఎదుట ఒక పాపి నీతిమంతుడిగా తీర్చబడుట.

chapters.Romans 5: In Romans 5:1 ('Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God...'), justification establishes that our war with God is permanently over and we are in peaceful fellowship with Him.

words.definition_en: The ongoing process by which the Holy Spirit sets believers apart and transforms them into Christlike holiness.
words.definition_te: విశ్వాసిని పాపమునుండి వేరుచేసి, క్రీస్తు సారూప్యములోనికి మార్చు పరిశుద్ధపరచబడు ప్రక్రియ.

chapters.1 Thessalonians 4: In 1 Thessalonians 4:3 ('For this is the will of God, even your sanctification...'), Paul emphasizes moral purity and honoring God with our bodies.

words.definition_en: Severe crushing trouble, affliction, or pressure. Derived from the Latin 'tribulum' (a threshing sledge that separates wheat from chaff).
words.definition_te: గోధుమల నుండి పొట్టును వేరుచేయు రోలు వంటి తీవ్రమైన శ్రమ, బాధ లేదా హింస.

chapters.John 16: In John 16:33 ('In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world'), Jesus comforts us that hardships will occur, but His victory overcomes all worldly suffering.

words.definition_en: A sacred, inviolable oath and relationship established between God and His people, sealed with blood.
words.definition_te: రక్తముతో ముద్రించబడిన దేవునికి మరియు ఆయన ప్రజలకు మధ్యగల పరిశుద్ధమైన విడదీయరాని నిబంధన.

chapters.Genesis 9: The Noahic covenant sealed with the rainbow promising never to flood the entire earth again.
chapters.Luke 22: The New Covenant established in the blood of Jesus at the Last Supper for eternal remission of sins.
